phrases: I arrived in London at last.
I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
我说英语不仅非常认真，而且非常清晰。
I repeated my question several times.
我把我的问题重复了好几次。
He spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
他说得既不慢也不清楚。
The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
行李员和我互相看着对方，笑了。
In England, each person speaks a different language.
在英国，每个人说不同的语言。
The English understand each other, but I don't understand them.
英国人彼此能理解，但我却听不懂他们。
I did not know the way to my hotel.
我不知道去我酒店的路。
所以我向一个行李员询问。

grammar.f: not only + 形容词/副词/动词 + but (also) + 形容词/副词/动词
grammar.d: 表示不仅有某种情况，而且有另一种情况，强调两个方面的关联性。 用于强调不仅有某一特征，还有另一特征，also有时可省略。
ex: She is not only beautiful but also intelligent.
He not only reads but also writes.

grammar.f: neither + A + nor + B (A和B通常为相同的词性)
grammar.d: 表示既不...也不...，用于否定两个并列的事物或动作。 当连接两个主语时，谓语动词与靠近的主语一致（就近一致原则）。
ex: He is neither tall nor short.
She speaks neither French nor German.
她既不会说法语也不会说德语。

grammar.f: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.d: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态。 常与表示过去的时间状语连用，如yesterday, last week, at last等。
ex: I arrived in London at last.
I did not know the way to my hotel.
我不知道去我酒店的路。

patterns.p: I did not know the way to + 地点, so I asked + 某人
o: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
我不知道去我酒店的路，所以我向一个行李员询问。
im: I did not know the way to the station, so I asked a policeman.
我不知道去车站的路，所以我向警察询问。
I did not know the way to the museum, so I asked a local.
我不知道去博物馆的路，所以我向当地人询问。

patterns.p: 主语 + could not + 动词原形
o: The porter, however, could not understand me.
然而，那个行李员听不懂我说话。
im: She could not speak English at that time.

patterns.p: 主语 + spoke neither + 副词A + nor + 副词B
o: He answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
他回答了我，但他说得既不慢也不清楚。
im: The teacher spoke neither fast nor slowly.
老师说得既不快也不慢。
He wrote neither neatly nor clearly.
他写得既不工整也不清楚。

patterns.p: 主语 + not only + 动词/形容词, but + also + 动词/形容词 + as well
o: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
我说英语不仅非常认真，而且非常清晰。
im: She not only works hard, but also smartly as well.
她不仅工作努力，而且聪明。
He not only came early, but also helped as well.
他不仅来得早，而且帮忙了。
